articles.summary: – Results Highlight the Potential of Long-Acting Regimens, Including Twice-Yearly and Once-Weekly Options, to Transform the Treatment and Prevention of HIV – Gilead Sciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: GILD) today announced its upcoming participation in the International Congress on Drug Therapy in HIV Infection ( HIV Glasgow 2026 ), taking place from November 8-11. As a leader in HIV innovation, Gilead will share new clinical data and real-world evidence from its HIV research and development programs and provide updates on its strategic initiatives and key collaborations. Results from more than 50 studies, including late-breaking data and two oral presentations, along with Gilead-led symposia and community forums, reflect the company’s person-centered approach to advancing scientific discovery and the importance of partnership to help end the HIV epidemic. articles.summary: - Data to be Presented at The Liver Meeting® Demonstrate Rapid and Sustained Improvements in ALP Levels with Livdelzi in Adults with PBC and ALP Levels Between 1-1.67 × ULN, Despite Receiving UDCA or with Intolerance to UDCA - - Gilead Will Engage Global Regulatory Authorities Based on These Results - Gilead Sciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: GILD) today announced the detailed results from the Phase 3 IDEAL study, which demonstrated that the majority of participants living with PBC and treated with Livdelzi ® (seladelpar) achieved the alkaline phosphatase (ALP) normalization composite endpoint defined as a composite of ALP ≤ 1.0× upper limit of normal (ULN) and a ≥ 15% decrease from baseline. ALP is a key marker of disease activity and long-term outcomes in PBC. These results can expand understanding of treatment effects and inform evolving treatment goals for people living with PBC.
